title: ID0416447/DC/Si-D/IL-[MP/R6 170002058] Circuit breaker tripped
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
On March 29, communication was lost at this charging station. I visited the station about two days ago, and upon opening the charging station door, I found that the circuit breaker had tripped.
This is the second occurrence in the last six months.
I would appreciate an explanation for why the circuit breaker tripped inside the station. I conducted some research but did not find any indication that it was caused by charging. At the time of the incident, the charging station was in Power Save Mode.
Solution: C
alibrated the QA2 circuit breaker to 23A.

additional_info.subject: Circuit breaker QA2 trips inside the charging station
